name: Dealroom
description: Dealroom lets agents search companies, investors, funding rounds and founders, and analyze investors and co-investors. Each user signs in to their own Dealroom account through the browser, and MCP access needs a Dealroom Premium seat.

prompts.text: Which climate tech startups in Europe raised a Series A this quarter?
Which companies did this investor back in the last two years?
Give me a profile of this startup: funding, investors, and headcount.

apps.name: Dealroom
apps.description: Companies, investors, funding rounds, and founders, over Dealroom's MCP server with browser sign-in.
